description.en-us: BIQU Panda Sense Pro is an 8-in-1 air quality monitoring module that tracks temperature, humidity, PM2.5, PM10, CO₂, formaldehyde, eTVOC, and AQI in real time, helping you better understand the air around your home, workspace, or 3D printing area.
description.zh-cn: BIQU Panda Sense Pro 是一款 8 合 1 空气质量监测模块，可实时监测温度、湿度、PM2.5、PM10、CO₂、甲醛、eTVOC 和 AQI，帮助您更好地了解家庭、工作空间或 3D 打印区域周围的空气质量。
